http.notes: Jasefly strips X-Powered-By to hide PHP/runtime versions (SecurityHeadersMiddleware + Apache Header always unset). Public identification uses the dedicated X-Jasefly header instead.

detection_rules: HTTP response header X-Jasefly equals 1 (any public URL, including / and API)
GET /.well-known/jasefly returns JSON {"platform":"Jasefly"} with no extra identity keys
Do not match WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or other CMS signatures
Any one of the three signals is sufficient; two or more is high confidence
